collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After a long, tiring day, a parent snaps at their child for spilling a basket of beans, and the child goes quiet.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a long, tiring day, (name1), a parent, snaps at their child for spilling a basket of beans, and the child goes quiet.

choices.label: Explain Being Tired Without Making Excuses.
Ask the Child How It Felt.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child hugs the parent, and they pick up the beans together.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The child needs a little while before speaking again, and the parent waits patiently.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child nods and says they get grumpy when tired too.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The child does not quite understand, but the parent's gentle voice helps.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They go for a short walk to the shore, and the evening ends well.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child would rather stay home, and they sit quietly instead.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The child says it was scary, and the parent promises to try harder.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The child shrugs and says it is fine, but the parent remembers the moment anyway.
